help.title: Help | Haedurio
help.description: Answers about paying, reply hours, hotel deliveries, refunds and your details, plus how to reach a person at Haedurio.
help.lead: Quick answers to common questions. For anything else, message a person.

faq.a: You pay once you accept your quote, with the payment link or details we send with it. Prices are in Korean won. For on-site tasks you can also pay in won, in cash.
Every day from 11:00 to 02:00, Korea time. You can message us any time, and we’ll reply when we’re open.

faq.q: Can you bring things to my hotel?
faq.a: Yes. Most hotels ask for a lobby handoff, which is {won:8000}. Tell us the hotel’s name and the name your room is booked under.

faq.q: Can you book a clinic or buy concert tickets for me?
faq.a: No. Korean law doesn’t allow us to book or recommend clinics, or to buy tickets for other people. We can go with you and interpret at a clinic you booked yourself, and point you to the official ticket seller.
No. We can’t carry passengers in our own cars. We’ll call a taxi for you, and ride along if you’d like help on arrival.

faq.q: What if you can’t finish my task?
faq.a: Online-only tasks are refunded in full. If we’ve already set off, part of the fee is kept. Money you haven’t used for items, food or taxis always comes back.

faq.q: What do you do with my details?
faq.a: We use them only to handle your request. We keep them for one year for support and disputes, then delete them. If a task needs a copy of your passport, we ask first, store it encrypted and delete it when the task is done.
English, Japanese, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Vietnamese and Thai. We handle the Korean side for you.

terms.title: Terms of service | Haedurio
terms.description: The terms for using Haedurio, the Seoul concierge service run by Whaleland: quotes, payment, refunds, what we don’t do, and responsibilities.
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use haedurio.com or ask Haedurio to do a task for you. Please read them before you accept a quote.

p: Haedurio is a concierge service for visitors in Korea, run by {company} ({address}, business registration no. {brn}, e-commerce registration no. {ecl}). In these terms, “we” and “us” mean Haedurio and {company}, and “you” means the person who asks us for help.

We carry out the tasks listed on our services page on your behalf and following your instructions: bookings, information checks, shopping, errands, interpretation, translation, parcels and lost-item help. We only take on tasks that are legal in Korea.

Before any task starts, we send you a quote in Korean won. A quote shows the service fee, the actual costs we expect, any extras, and the refund rule for that task. A task starts only after you accept the quote. If the work changes, we send a new quote before going further.

You pay once you accept the quote, using the payment link or details we send with it. For on-site tasks, you can also pay in Korean won, in cash, when we agree this in advance. Dollar amounts on our site are a guide only.
Items, food, taxi fares, deposits and postage are charged at the price we actually pay, plus a 4.5% handling fee. We send receipts or photos as proof. Money that isn’t used comes back to you.
You can cancel at any time before a task starts, and get back everything you paid.
If we can’t finish a task, or you cancel after it starts, the refund rule written on your quote applies:
list: Online and remote tasks: the service fee is refunded in full.
On-site tasks, once we’ve set off: 35% of the service fee (at least {won:31000}) is kept and the rest is refunded.
Queueing and companion tasks, once queueing or the visit has started: 50% of the service fee (at least {won:70000}) is kept and the rest is refunded.
after: Unused money for items, food or taxis is always refunded. Cancellation fees charged by shops, venues or couriers can’t be refunded. We send refunds to the original payment method within 3 business days of confirming them.

p: We don’t book or recommend clinics or hospitals, buy or resell event tickets, buy or deliver medicine, alcohol or tobacco, lend phone numbers or accounts for identity checks, give rides in our own cars, prepare or submit government documents, give legal advice, book hotels, flights, trains or tours, or exchange or transfer money. We also don’t handle anything banned by Korean law. We can still go with you and interpret, for example at a clinic you booked yourself.

Please give us accurate details and tell us about anything that could affect the task. Only ask for things that are legal for you to buy, carry or ship. When we ship abroad, you are responsible for the import rules and duties of the destination country.

We take reasonable care with every task. Shops, restaurants, couriers and other businesses are responsible for their own goods and services, including quality, delays and sold-out items, but we’ll help you sort out problems with them. If something goes wrong because of our mistake, we’ll make it right, up to the amount you paid us for that task. This limit doesn’t apply where Korean law says otherwise, including when we act intentionally or with gross negligence.
We handle personal information as described in our {privacy}.
We may update these terms. The version on this page when you accept a quote applies to that task.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. Any dispute will be handled by the Seoul Central District Court, unless Korean law gives you the right to use another court.
Questions about these terms: {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy | Haedurio
privacy.description: What personal information Haedurio collects, why, how long we keep it, who we share it with, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {company} handles your personal information when you use Haedurio, in line with Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act.

p: When you send a request: your name, the chat app ID, phone number or email you want us to reply on, your reply language, and the details you write about the task.
When a task needs it: delivery addresses, hotel names and the name a room is booked under, recipient details for shipping, and booking names.
Only for tasks that legally require it, such as collecting a lost item on your behalf, and only with your consent: a copy of your passport.
To keep the site safe: technical data such as your IP address and browser type, processed by our hosting and spam-protection providers.

list: To reply to you, quote and carry out your request
To take payments and send refunds
To give support and handle disputes
To keep the site and our services safe from abuse
after: We don’t use your information for advertising, and we don’t sell it.

list: Request and support details: 1 year after your task ends, then deleted.
Passport copies: deleted as soon as the task is done, and no later than 30 days after.

Records that Korean law requires us to keep, such as payment and contract records under the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce (5 years) and complaint records (3 years): only for the period that law requires.
after: When the time is up, we delete digital files permanently and shred paper copies.

p: We share only what a task needs with the business involved, for example the name for a restaurant booking or a delivery address for a courier. We also share information when the law requires it.

sections.h: Service providers and transfers outside Korea
p: We use these providers to run the site and handle requests. They may store or process data on servers outside Korea. Data is sent over encrypted connections when you submit a form or message us, and kept for the periods above.

head: Provider
Country
What it does
rows: Stores the requests you send through this site
Checks that form submissions aren’t spam (Turnstile)

after: If you message us on WhatsApp, LINE, WeChat or KakaoTalk, that app’s own privacy policy also applies. You can refuse these transfers by not using the form and emailing us instead, but we may then be unable to reply as quickly.

p: Only staff who need your information for a task can see it. Passport copies are stored encrypted. The site uses encrypted HTTPS connections.

We don’t use advertising or tracking cookies. Your browser keeps your language choice, and a draft of a request you haven’t sent yet, on your device. Our spam-protection provider may process technical data to tell people from bots.
Our services are for adults. We don’t knowingly collect personal information from children under 14.

You can ask to see, correct or delete your information, or ask us to stop using it, by emailing {email}. We reply within 10 days. If you’re not satisfied, you can contact the Personal Information Infringement Report Center (privacy.kisa.or.kr, +82 118) or the Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (kopico.go.kr).
{officer}, CEO of {company}. Email: {email}. Phone: {phone}.
If we change this policy, we’ll post the new version here with a new date.
